This is a real defect/unfinished behavior introduced by this diff, explicitly acknowledged by the author.

judged_text: addMembers leaves the user-selector populated after adding — the diff's own `// TODO: should clear the input` marks the flow as unfinished — so the just-submitted usernames stay in the input. A second click on Add (double-click, or adding a different user later) silently re-submits the stale username list to add_members, which reports success without distinguishing new adds from already-member entries, giving the admin no feedback on what actually happened.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and then calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without resetting `this.usernames`. In `group.hbs`, the `{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}` component is bound to that same controller property, so the submitted usernames will remain in the input after a successful add. A subsequent click on “Add” will re-send the same `usernames` string to `Admin::GroupsController#add_members` (which does not provide any per-username feedback), matching the finding’s described behavior.
